  • Method Details

    • anchor

      public MKHudPanel.Builder anchor(MKHudAnchor anchor, int offsetX, int offsetY)
      Sets the screen-edge anchor and offset.

      Mutually exclusive with region(com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.HudRegion) — calling both throws IllegalStateException. Migration is a single commit per consumer (delete .anchor(), add .region()); there is no intentional transitional state.

    • region

      public MKHudPanel.Builder region(HudRegion region)
      Positions this HUD panel via a named HudRegion. The dispatch computes per-frame coordinates from the region's anchor and the panel's stacking position relative to other panels in the same region. See M5 design doc §3.5 for the region catalog.

      Mutually exclusive with anchor(MKHudAnchor, int, int) — calling both throws IllegalStateException.

    • region

      public MKHudPanel.Builder region(RegionAnchor<HudRegion> anchor)
      Region overload accepting a RegionAnchor — region paired with an explicit stacking priority. Phase 16i. Equivalent to .region(anchor.region()) but passes the priority through to the registry so this panel sorts deterministically relative to other panels in the same region.

    • showWhen

      public MKHudPanel.Builder showWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Sets a visibility condition — panel only renders when true. Uses BooleanSupplier (no boxing), unified with Panel.showWhen(BooleanSupplier) and the element-level showWhen/disabledWhen/revealWhen predicate type. Method references (e.g. HUD::isOn) and () -> ... lambdas satisfy both, so call sites are unaffected.

    • custom

      public MKHudPanel.Builder custom(int childX, int childY, int width, int height, Consumer<RenderContext> renderFn)
      Adds a custom render region. The lambda receives the per-frame RenderContext for its position and graphics handle. The declared width/height are the element's bounds for layout.
      Parameters:
      childX - panel-relative X position
      childY - panel-relative Y position
      width - region width (used for auto-sizing)
      height - region height (used for auto-sizing)
      renderFn - render callback invoked each frame

    • element

      public MKHudPanel.Builder element(PanelElement element)
      Adds any panel element directly. Escape hatch for consumers that implement PanelElement themselves.

    • build

      public void build()
      Builds the HUD panel definition and registers it with MenuKit. After this call, the panel renders automatically each frame.

      If region(com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.HudRegion) was called, the def is also registered with RegionRegistry so its stacked position resolves against other panels in the same region. Registration order is build() call order.
